detail.longDescription: Shadow Agents, Standing Privileges, and the Governance Gap Between Deployment and Discovery 🚨 AI security crisis in 2026: Only 1% of orgs use just-in-time access while 91% leave privileges always-on. Shadow AI tools tripled, with 75% of CISOs finding unsanctioned agents in production. Documented ransomware attacks exploited persistent agent access. Urgent need: strict governance, permission monitoring, and guardrail enforcement. https://www. oreilly.com/radar/shadow-agent s-standing-privileges-and-the-governance-gap-between-deployment-and-discovery/ # AI # MachineLearning
